name: camphor (synthetic) + menthol + phenol
uses: Uses: For the temporary relief of minor pain, itching, or pain and itching associated with minor burns, sunburn, minor cuts, scrapes, insect bites, minor skin irritations.
otcwarn: Do not use on damaged or broken skin. Stop use and ask a doctor if rash or irritation develops and lasts. condition worsens, or if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again with in a few days.
